overview: Two-arm cluster randomised trial on 16 adult wards randomised in eight pairs of wards that share float staff: four pairs switch on real-time badge feedback with weekly dashboards and four continue silent monitoring, from January to June 2027. The planning basis is under review because the retrieved trial's record has changed.
population: Hand hygiene opportunities at patient-zone entry by all staff groups on the 16 wards; float and agency staff included and flagged.
exposure: Real-time vibration feedback within ten seconds of patient-zone entry without hand hygiene, and weekly ward dashboards shown at the safety huddle.
procedures: Pairs are allocated by computer-generated sequence stratified by medical or surgical specialty. External observers from the regional network observe 25 hours per ward in sessions at random times, wearing the same visible identification on both arms; they record opportunity type, staff group, float status and hand hygiene. Badge data are extracted at ward level for the secondary outcome.

outcomes.name: Directly observed compliance
outcomes.measure: Proportion of observed opportunities at patient-zone entry with hand rub or hand washing, recorded by external observers
outcomes.why: Independent of the feedback system (claim c3).

outcomes.name: Badge system compliance
outcomes.measure: Ward-level compliance recorded by the badge system
outcomes.why: Shows how far the system's figure departs from observed behaviour.

outcomes.name: Patient sleep disturbance by alerts
outcomes.measure: Nurse-recorded night alerts in shared bays and patient complaints

outcomes.name: Staff acceptability
outcomes.measure: Short anonymous questionnaire by staff group at month 5
outcomes.why: Trust in the monitoring agreement must not be lost.

feasibility: 400 observer-hours give about 300 observed opportunities per ward; the feedback switch needs no new hardware.
biasMitigation: Pairs of wards sharing float staff randomised together
External observers with identical visibility on both arms
Observation sessions at random times scheduled centrally
Primary analysis fixed before the first observation session

biasFlags.label: Observer visibility
biasFlags.note: Equal on both arms; absolute compliance still overstated.

biasFlags.label: Contamination by float staff
biasFlags.note: Paired randomisation and float status recorded.

biasFlags.label: Planning effect size under correction
biasFlags.note: The record behind the planning effect has changed; the decision is stale until re-reviewed.

flags: Adjustment for baseline ward compliance and specialty only
parsimony.simplestPath: One observed outcome, eight randomised pairs, one adjusted comparison.

theoreticalFramework: No framework beyond the trial design; TIDieR for describing the feedback intervention.
summary: Paired cluster randomised trial with an independent observed primary outcome; planning basis flagged as under review.
